name: Pulse Music v4.2.7 - Instant App Startup & Immediate Spotify / Playlist Loading
body:
# Pulse Music v4.2.7 - Instant App Startup & Immediate Spotify / Playlist Loading

Official multi-platform release and global OTA update for **Android**, **Windows**, **Orion Store**, **F-Droid**, **Obtainium**, and **Web**.

---

### ⚡ Instant App Startup & Immediate Spotify Playlist Display
- **0ms Cache-First Startup Across All Playlists**: Persisted Spotify Playlists, Spotify Trending Playlists, Spotify Trending Songs, Spotify Recently Played, YouTube Library Playlists, and Mixed For You shelves locally and emits cached items immediately on app launch while refreshing cleanly in the background.
- **No Shimmer Stalls Blocking Home**: Exits the Home loading shimmer immediately as soon as any cached or live Spotify list arrives, uses `SharingStarted.Eagerly` for Spotify session visibility, starts Spotify loading first in `HomeViewModel.init`, and decouples Home, Mood, Chart, and New Releases into independent parallel collectors so secondary feeds never stall initial Home rendering.

### 🚀 Faster Spotify Session & Parallel Playlist Fetching
- **Shared Singleton Spotify Engine & Vault-First Hashes**: Shared Koin's single warm `Spotify` session inside `PlaylistRepositoryImpl` instead of recreating a separate cold instance, added instant DataStore token seeding (`seedSessionFromCache`), added fast HTML session warmup (`warmHtmlQuick`), and switched `SpotApiBundleSession.resolveQueryHash` to return Vault-known query hashes immediately without blocking on multi-megabyte bundle/chunk downloads.
- **Parallelized Playlist & Chart Fetches**: Concurrently executes `/v1/me/playlists` + Pathfinder `libraryV3`, paginated playlist pages, editorial chart metadata queries, and trending track fetches.
- **Instant Opening for Any Playlist & Library Tab**: `PlaylistViewModel` renders cached Room playlist tracks immediately before network refresh, removes the artificial `500ms` post-insert wait, and `LibraryViewModel` preserves visible playlists instead of flashing spinners when switching tabs.
changelog: Instant App Opening & Spotify Lists: Persisted Spotify Playlists, Trending, Recently Played, YouTube Library, and Mixed For You caches locally for immediate 0ms display on startup
Zero Shimmer Stalls: Unlocks Home immediately when cached or live Spotify shelves arrive, decouples Home/Mood/Chart/NewRelease into parallel collectors, and fixes Eager Spotify state collection
Faster SpotAPI Cold Start: Shares Koin's single Spotify session across repositories, seeds cached tokens immediately, uses fast HTML session extraction, and parallelizes user/chart playlist requests
Instant Playlist & Library Switching: Renders cached Room playlists immediately on open and removes tab-switch loading flashes in Library
